title: Neutropenia and Febrile Neutropenia: Clinical Red Flags
subject: Hematology & ABG
preview: Neutropenia increases infection risk; fever during severe neutropenia can indicate a medical emergency.
quickRevision: Neutropenia increases infection risk; fever during severe neutropenia can indicate a medical emergency.
Prompt assessment, cultures where possible and empiric antimicrobials according to institutional risk pathways are important.
Consider chemotherapy, marrow disease, drugs and infection as potential causes of neutropenia.

sections.title: Interpret the result in context
points: Neutropenia increases infection risk; fever during severe neutropenia can indicate a medical emergency.
Symptoms of infection may be muted because the inflammatory response is reduced.

sections.title: Clinical interpretation & next steps
points: Prompt assessment, cultures where possible and empiric antimicrobials according to institutional risk pathways are important.
Consider chemotherapy, marrow disease, drugs and infection as potential causes of neutropenia.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not dismiss fever in a neutropenic patient because the examination lacks pus or marked redness.

quiz.question: Why can infection be difficult to recognize in neutropenia?
options: Inflammatory signs may be less prominent
quiz.explanation: Inflammatory signs may be less prominent. Symptoms of infection may be muted because the inflammatory response is reduced.
